title: Your Raleigh explorer passport
summary: Five different public places. Explore at your pace, keep your progress on this device, and leave something useful for the next person.

descriptions.dix-park: A large destination park with skyline lawns, play areas, public art, trails, a dog park, and widely separated destinations that reward planning.
descriptions.pullen-park: A family-centered park combining a historic carousel, miniature train, playgrounds, arts, sports, and other facilities with separate schedules.
descriptions.john-chavis-memorial-park: A historic community park with a restored carousel, playground, splash pad, track, community center, and connections to Raleigh's Black history.
descriptions.moore-square: A compact downtown square with open lawn, mature oaks, seating, events, and easy walking connections to surrounding destinations.
descriptions.basic-osm-way-33106145: A smaller downtown green space with lawns, paved paths, shade trees, benches, and a significant civic namesake.
